source.name: Square People – HR, Payroll & ESS for Business Central

mapping.summary: GCC HR, payroll and employee self-service built inside Business Central
claims: Localized for UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait
Generates WPS salary files including UAE SIF
Calculates GOSI contributions and Mudad/WPS files for Saudi Arabia
End-of-service gratuity per local labour law
Multi-country, multi-entity payroll on one BC tenant
Final settlement with gratuity, leave encashment and deductions in one run
Payroll posts automatically to G/L with dimensions and audit trail
Trial payroll runs for review before posting
Overtime per local labour law with compensatory off
Ramadan working hours and country public holidays
Staff loans and salary advances deducted through payroll
Tracks annual and family air ticket entitlements
Employee self-service app on web, iOS and Android
Managers approve requests from their phone
Priced at USD 3,600 per company per year
